hints.title: Two Consecutive Closing Parentheses Rule
hints.text: Every open parenthesis must be matched with two consecutive closing parentheses.

hints.title: Closing Pair Lookahead
hints.text: When encountering a closing parenthesis, check if the subsequent character is also a closing parenthesis. If so, consume both; otherwise, add 1 insertion.

hints.title: Deficit Balancing
hints.text: Maintain the count of unmatched open parentheses. If a closing pair arrives with zero open available, add 1 insertion for an open parenthesis.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Stack memory is unnecessary when counters track open balance and insertions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single forward pass with two integer counters uses O(1) space and O(N) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles consecutive right parenthesis lookahead and balances unmatched left parentheses at the end.
complexity.notes: Each remaining open parenthesis requires two closing insertions.
